summary.text: The Cabaretti are one of the five crime families of New Capenna, a party-minded family led by Jetmir and associated with food, celebration and the Halo.

bio.text: In Old Capenna the Cabaretti served as druids, and after leaving nature their festivals became constant parties.
The family was said to have figured out how to make Halo and to hold the Font, and Giada, a teenage girl able to turn sewage into pure Halo, was its secret source.
Lagrella infiltrated the family to steal a sample of Halo, and the Adversary, revealed as Ob Nixilis, learned what the Font was and planned to take over at the Crescendo.
At the Crescendo the Adversary's infiltrators revealed themselves, and the Cabaretti were neutralized and Jetmir gravely wounded.
Jinnie and Cabaretti enforcers then stormed a warehouse office and held a knife to Elspeth's throat.
During the New Phyrexian Invasion the Cabaretti were absent from New Capenna's defense.

status.text: The Cabaretti are still led by Jetmir, who remained active after the slaughter, though the family was absent when the invasion struck New Capenna.
